text.text_excerpt: This is the neighborhood bar everyone wishes they had within walking distance of their place. Thankfully, it was super close to our hotel, and we hit it up 3 times in our short weekend trip. Bartenders are super nice and welcoming. We had breakfast here (they serve their breakfast dish all day!) and chatted with the bartender. She gave some GREAT suggestions for local eats. Brownie points! Backspace is great for an afternoon snack (check out their selection of light bites), a late night dinner, and everything inbetween. The specialty cocktails are a must order, and you cannot beat their prices on beer. The fireplace is a great area to chill, but I would say this place is better for groups...

I just recently moved to the French Quarter and now live just two blocks from this gem. Decided to stop in for a quick bite and a drink with a few friends before we went parading on a Friday night. We were greeted with water by this sweet bartender named Chappy. I explained I was a recent transplant and she immediate started offering advice about the do's and don'ts of the area. She was amazing! When we went to order she offered advice and was very well versed by the menu. One of my friends is very picky about how his old fashion should taste, Chappy did not disappoint him, he loved it. I got the grilled cheese with the home made chips, it was so good. Great atmosphere and staff, and very...

I just loved this cozy little bar tucked away in the French Quarter. David and I stopped in here on our anniversary night and the first thing I noticed was their menu. Sure, it's a bar, but they have some seriously good sounding food and I ALMOST wished that I hadn't eaten before I got here. The feel of the bar is meant to be like an old library with booze, and I'm all about that. The place is pretty dimly lit, which adds to a nice cozy vibe and I loved that they had a pretty good beer selection. They have a few comfy chairs to sit in, but we just hung out at the bar and took it all in. The patrons seem to be neighborhood regulars and we enjoyed just sipping our drinks and people watching...
